thread:
maria-g: Started an incident channel — multiple customers reporting 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference around 17:03 UTC. High P50/P95 on gateway, looks like retry amplification from clients hitting us. opening warroom. @leo can you grab traces?
leo: on it. measuring spike now, p95 latency to /v1/generate up from 200ms to >2s, error rate ~8% across eu-west and us-central. seeing a lot of 502/504 at the edge.
aj: initial look in ingress logs shows many repeated POST /v1/generate from same client tokens causing connection queuing. sample: 
```
POST /v1/generate  ->  upstream 504 (timeout) x 12 retries
client_id=acme-42 tokens=1200
```

support-bot: Noted high-sev customer alerts: AcmeCorp, Shopline, PaperCo. Support pages updated with "investigating".
sarah-k: Can we confirm if this is KV cache or batcher backlog? those have caused similar waves before.
leo: KV cache hit-rate is normal. the batcher queues show an increased inflight and long tail for prefill for >3s. root cause looks like upstream proxy keepalive resets -> new conn handshakes -> server-side queue growth.
maria-g: hypothesis: edge proxy (our envoy fleet) started closing idle conns due to a config change in the last deploy window (03:50 UTC). any deploys?
ops-pete: there was a small edge tweak at 03:48 to keepalive=60s -> 20s for TLS farms. rolling change targeted to reduce idle sockets. rolling back now.
aj: rolling back, taking one region off rotation during rollback to test.
leo: once we disabled new config in eu-west at 17:15, error rate dropped from 8% -> 1.2% within 4 minutes. us-central rollback in progress.
support-bot: Customer comms: sent interim note to AcmeCorp and Shopline at 17:20 — update: degraded, mitigation in progress.
sarah-k: Nice catch. need to capture reproducible steps for postmortem. Repro: 1) set keepalive low on edge, 2) run many concurrent short-lived clients with retries (curl loop) 3) observe upstream queue growth and 504 amplification.
maria-g: paste of simple repro script shared in thread: 
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"input":"short"}' & done
```

leo: attached logs (snips) show a lot of TLS handshake latencies ~120ms vs baseline 10ms, and a surge of new TCP connects per second.
ops-pete: mitigation checklist we executed: 
- rolled edge keepalive config rollback (done)
- temporarily increased route circuit-breaker thresholds (done)
- added short-term token-level rate limiting on most noisy clients (in progress)
- notified support/sales for comms (done)
- scheduled extended tracing for next 48h (done)

aj: follow-ups — need permanent fix: revert config permanently or test keepalive values and add readiness checks to prevent rolling low keepalive across all nodes. Also add metrics to detect new-conn rate vs baseline and automated rollback.
sarah-k: action items for postmortem: 
- owner: ops-pete -> run a canary with keepalive=20s on a subset and run synthetic load to validate (ETA 48h)
- owner: leo -> produce timeline and bundle traces for affected customers (ETA 24h)
- owner: maria-g -> update runbook with retry-amplification chapter and add recommended client retry policies (ETA 72h)
- owner: aj -> add automated alert for new-conn-rate > 2x baseline (ETA 24h)
- owner: support -> finalize templated customer comms and retrospective note (ETA 48h)

maria-g: I'll draft a short postmortem once we have traces and exact deploy id. Thanks everyone for quick mitigation. :raised_hands:
leo: quick note — we should consider adding a short-term smoothing layer at the gateway to absorb retry storms (token-leaky-bucket). prototype ready, can test next week.
ops-pete: noted. scheduling follow-up meeting 2pm PST tomorrow to review Canary plan and action items.
support-bot: Incident closed at 17:35 UTC for customer impact; monitoring continues.
maria-g: Closing comments: root cause = edge keepalive misconfiguration causing connection churn + retry amplification from aggressive clients. Primary remediation = rollback + token rate limit + add new-conn alert. Postmortem owners and ETAs above.
leo: sending timeline and logs to the incident binder now.
aj: thanks team. We'll convert action items into tracked tickets and follow through. :white_check_mark:
